title: Rack of Lamb
description: French-trimmed rack of lamb oven-roasted and served with a spiced plum and demi glace sauce.

ingredients.notes: Don't add too much all at once — you can't take it out once it's in.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 200°C. Season the lamb rack generously with salt.
Heat a little oil in an ovenproof pan over high heat. Sear the lamb rack on all sides until well browned, about 3–4 minutes total.
Transfer the pan to the oven and roast for 15–18 minutes for medium-rare. Remove and rest on a warm plate for 5 minutes.
For the sauce: in a small saucepan, combine plum jam, chilli, garlic, soy sauce, and white wine over medium heat. Stir until the jam melts and the mixture is smooth.
Add demi glace and simmer for 3–4 minutes until reduced to a glossy, coating consistency. Taste and adjust — the soy and plum provide both salt and sweetness.
Carve the rack into individual cutlets. Plate and spoon the spiced plum sauce over the top.

notes.title: Plum Sauce
notes.content: The sauce is made from plum jam melted with soy, garlic, chilli, wine and demi glace — not a commercial plum sauce. The heat level is adjustable: one chilli gives a gentle warmth that balances the sweet plum without overpowering the lamb.

notes.title: Resting is Essential
notes.content: Rest the lamb for a full 5 minutes before carving. This allows the juices to redistribute throughout the meat rather than running out onto the plate.
